mechanism: Finite State Machine. A {{transition}} is defined as T: S x Event -> S. Only valid transitions allowed. Current {{state}} determines available actions.
invariants: Only declared transitions are permitted; an event with no transition from the current {{state}} is refused, not improvised.
The available actions are a function of the current {{state}} alone.
failure_modes: Undeclared event: an event arrives that the machine has no transition for, and a caller treats the refusal as a failure of the event rather than of the model.
Unreachable state: a state is declared with no transition leading to it.
